mainHero.subtitle: Dream Rental.
mainHero.description: Find your perfect living space hassle-free with Owl! Enjoy secure housing wherever you desire, without the stress of overbidding or uncertainty. 🏡

items.title: Our Goals
items.description: We are college students who are impacted by the difficulty of finding a house in major cities. With our all-in-one platform, we want to help many others just like us by assisting them with suggesting fitting roommates, finding a comfortable house and making sure the payments are made conveniently. We want to start from the 400,000 missing houses in the Netherlands and, in the future, expand to helping out with the housing crisis globally!
items.old_description: We're a software startup dedicated to tackling housing shortages in crisis cities, starting with the Netherlands. Through our AI roommate & rental-matching system, we aim to streamline the searching process, saving you money and ensuring a stress-free housing experience anywhere you choose to live. Our circular economic model optimizes existing rentals, aiming to cut the government's anticipated 100,000 annual new construction target in half. This facilitates more efficient budget allocation and provides landlords with a secure rent payment method. Plus, who knows? Like Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia, who met as roommates and founded Airbnb, you might just find your perfect partner(s) too!

items.title: Our Achievements
items.description:
As an idea stage startup, we got accepted into some top incubator programs like Founder's Institute and LaunchCLT's Co.starters program. 
 After proceeding without an incubator, we won Nisbet Venture's Audience Choice Award and later won 1st place in Avinger Impact Fund!
